notes: Collision-proof cloud keys: every installation now gets an immutable Instance ID (a permanent UUID) that the cloud mirror is keyed against, so two PCs can never overwrite each other — even if they use the same location label. The label is now just a friendly display name (rename anytime in Settings > System Identity). Your mirror link is shown in Settings with a Copy button, in the form https://tdqsys.pages.dev/client.html?id=INSTANCE. Existing installs keep their data: your PC's Instance ID is generated automatically on first launch after updating. Backups still carry your id, so a reinstall + restore keeps the same mirror link.
